title: OSC conditional $620 million commitment to Vulcan Elements
summary: Conditional loan commitment; not treated as a disbursed loan or outlay.

sources.title: Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment

data.name: Vulcan Elements OSC conditional loan commitment
data.outcome: Office of Strategic Capital announced a $620 million conditional loan commitment to Vulcan Elements. Conditions and due diligence must be satisfied before disbursement.

caveats: Commitment is not an outlay and must not be described as fully disbursed.
